answer: Each of 192 aliases needs its own health logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A poultry keeper registration with flock health logs works as the gate: flock health logged at one holding for years. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The horizon record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the wharf entry is checkable by anyone, and the lagoon window closes before a farm can catch up.
